{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify that all values are now numeric and valid
# Check for any remaining invalid values
invalid_after_clean = df['revenue_clean'].isnull().sum()

# Check the first few cleaned revenue values
df[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head(10)

# Display result
invalid_after_clean"}
